Main menu
Controls & information

Click a portrait or worker to select. Shift-click toggles a merc; Shift-drag on the map selects a group. Ground clicks move the group. Walk / Run / Sneak and stance changes apply to the selected group.

WASD / arrows or drag to pan. Scroll to zoom. Keys 1–3 choose the interaction level. S beside a portrait opens stances; I opens Inventory, free to look. Reload and weapon swap affect that character.

Run: 50% less AP, double speed. Sneak: 50% more AP, half speed, +20 stealth.

Easy reveals exteriors. Room interiors stay hidden until observed; opponents still require visual awareness. ? marks a glimpse or remembered position.
